notes: LIVE GUIDE CHANGED since the 7 Oct copy: BarBurrito removed Cholula Sweet Lime Chicken (16 entries across the burritos, bowls, kids and nachos menus; every other entry, kcal and allergen line is identical), so the script's expected entry counts were updated (187/143/33/71) and data/source re-generated from the fresh pages (168 items, was 171; 3 items gone: Cholula Sweet Lime Chicken, Lil' and Loaded versions; dates now 2026-10-08). The only figure printed is kcal (no protein/carbs/fat).
